stem.text: A skydiver is falling vertically with terminal velocity when their parachute opens fully.
Which statement describes the motion of the skydiver for the first few seconds after the parachute opens fully?

A.text: falling with non-uniform acceleration and increasing speed

B.text: falling with non-uniform acceleration and decreasing speed

C.text: falling with uniform acceleration and increasing speed

D.text: falling with uniform acceleration and decreasing speed
